module: Plays the credits music (FMOD event "event:>Music>credits" on the AudioGui channel) with volume fades. Loading the extension starts the music with a 0.4 s fade-in; unloading deletes the sound source.
usage:
extensions.load('ui_credits')
-- later:
ui_credits.stopWithFade(1.0, function() extensions.unload('ui_credits') end)
notes: The fade is advanced in onUpdate with dtReal (real time, independent of pause).
The minimum duration of a fade is 0.001 s.
The volume functions do nothing if the sound object has no setVolume method.

startWithFade.desc: Creates the credits sound source if needed, starts it at volume 0 if it is not yet playing, then fades to volume 1.

returns.desc: false if the sound source could not be created, otherwise true.

stopWithFade.desc: Fades to 0 then stops and deletes the source, then calls onStopped. If there is no sound, stops immediately.

onStopped.desc: Callback with no argument called once the music has stopped.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads: starts startWithFade with the default duration (0.4 s).

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called on unload: stops and deletes the sound source and frees the parameter group.

onUpdate.desc: Hook called every frame: advances the current fade and calls its callback at the end.

dtReal.desc: Real time elapsed since the last frame (s).
